design_philosophy: Ritual is an ultra-premium, cross-venue loyalty platform. It must feel like an exclusive members' club or airline elite-status program, drawing heavily from editorial, fashion-magazine aesthetics (think Kinfolk or a NYT editorial spread). Reject food delivery or standard nightlife app cliches. Design should be expensive, restrained, and considered.

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight text-[#F4F4EE]

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, or py-24 for section breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.cards: Invitations, not listings. Large imagery, minimal text overlay, subtle gradients (from-black/80 to-transparent). Avoid hard borders.
layout_and_spacing.grids: Asymmetric grids. Avoid default equal columns. Mix large dominant hero cells with supporting smaller ones.
layout_and_spacing.general: No more than one primary action per screen. Generous negative space.

components.button_primary: bg-[#C2A36B] text-[#0F0F0F] hover:bg-[#D1B37D] px-8 py-3 rounded-none transition-colors duration-300 font-medium tracking-wide text-sm
components.button_secondary: border border-[#2A2A2A] text-[#F4F4EE] hover:bg-[#1E1E1E] px-8 py-3 rounded-none transition-colors duration-300 tracking-wide text-sm
components.navigation: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0F0F0F]/60) with subtle bottom border (border-white/5). Never use a fully transparent header over content.
components.icons: Thin-line icons only (use lucide-react with strokeWidth={1} or {1.5}). No filled or cartoon icons.

motion.transitions: Subtle fade/slide transitions, duration-500 to duration-700, ease-out. No bouncy or playful animations.
motion.interactions: Every interaction should feel deliberate and unhurried.

venue_nightlife.description: Martini glass at a dark bar

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark theme is implemented by default with deep charcoal (#0F0F0F) rather than pure black.
Use a single, restrained accent color (Warm Gold/Champagne). Apply it strictly for key actions, tier indicators, and primary CTAs.
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' (or similar elegant serif) for large numerical displays (e.g., Ritual Points balance) and Venue Names.
Structure UI hierarchically with massive scale contrast. Huge thin serifs paired with tiny, widely tracked all-caps overlines (e.g., 'MEMBER SINCE', 'RITUAL POINTS').
Avoid typical food app metrics (no bright star ratings, no red/orange notification dots). Use words like 'Quiet', 'Filling In', 'At Capacity' for venue status.
Language must be editorial: 'A table awaits', 'Your Ritual continues', 'Inner Circle Access'.
Implement Mobile-First layout. Navigation must be seamless for one-handed use.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards with thick borders or bright drop shadows. Make surfaces blend organically or use subtle 1px white/5 borders.
Image overlays should never exceed bg-black/50, ensuring photography remains a focal point.
For the check-in flow and wallet, mimic the UX of a premium airline boarding pass or high-end hotel digital key.
Status tiers should be presented visually: Guest -> Regular -> Devotee -> Inner Circle.

accessibility.text_contrast: Ensure off-white/cream text on charcoal backgrounds passes APCA and WCAG AA guidelines.
accessibility.focus_states: Focus outlines should be a subtle 1px ring in Warm Gold.

testing.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not apply universal transition. e.g.: transition: all. Add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
Do not center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
NEVER use placeholder text for missing images. Use provided image URLs.
Avoid generic, on-distribution outputs like typical SaaS blue/gray. Make it distinctive.
